messages:
Sam (People Ops): Hey @channel — heads up: PDX heating plant failure affecting floors 1-5. Building management says no heat until Tuesday evening (ETA 2026-04-07 18:00 PDT). Please read below for options and immediate guidance.

Renee (Facilities): Confirmed. HVAC techs onsite now; temporary heaters being set up in common zones but those are not long-term. Priority is comfort + safety.

Jordan - Eng: bummer. will wifi and badge access be affected?

IT Ops Bot: Network status: no degradation detected. Badge readers operational. If you get locked out, DM facilities and cc it-ops.

Anya: is there a temperature threshold where we should send people home? i have an immunocompromised guest coming in.

Renee (Facilities): Good question. Per our policy, we recommend remote work if workspace temp < 65F for prolonged occupancy. If guests have special needs, please escalate to People Ops and well arrange alternative space.

Sam (People Ops): Options: 1) Work remotely until heating fixed. 2) Use our temporary coworking stipend for this week (we prebooked desks at TwoBlock Coworking — see link). 3) Swing desks on floors 6-8 which are heated (limited). Were covering coworking passes and ride share for PDX employees for commutes to TwoBlock between 8am-8pm.

Coworking Ops: TwoBlock pass link: https://twoblock.example/pdx-redwood-4_2026 (use company email to check in). We reserved 40 desks Wed-Thu.

Jordan - Eng: how do we request a rideshare?

Sam (People Ops): Fill this short form: https://forms.redwood.example/pdx-heating-commute. Ops will approve rideshare and send code for Lyft/Uber. If you drove and need parking at TwoBlock, say so on the form.

Anya: reimbursement question — if i book a coworking pass myself first, can i expense it?

Sam (People Ops): Yes — expense code PDX-HVAC. If you booked before we posted, include receipt and tag People Ops; well auto-approve within 24h. Policy: up to $50/day coworking or rideshare cap at $25 one-way.

Renee (Facilities): Safety: no space heaters allowed at desks. Personal heaters will be confiscated for fire safety. Well have certified portable heaters in common areas only.

Jordan - Eng: will there be food/snacks if we move to TwoBlock?

Sam (People Ops): Were providing boxed lunches Wed and Thu for people who check into TwoBlock via the link. Dietary restrictions form on the same page.

IT Ops Bot: Reminder: VPN profile for TwoBlock wifi posted in #eng-it. If you have trouble authenticating, restart your VPN client and open a ticket.

Anya: what about team meetings planned in-person this week?

Sam (People Ops): We suggest switching to virtual if >10 people. If you must meet in-person, book one of the heated floors (6-8) or reserve space at TwoBlock. Bookings will be prioritized for ADA needs and essential on-site tasks.

Renee (Facilities): Well post signs by the lobby and elevators. Facilities desk open 8am-6pm for check-ins and to hand out emergency blankets if needed.

Jordan - Eng: thanks — appreciate the quick response.

Sam (People Ops): TL;DR: PDX floors 1-5 no heat until Tues evening, remote or TwoBlock passes + rideshare supported, expense code PDX-HVAC, no personal heaters, boxed lunches for TwoBlock attendees. Fill the commute form or DM People Ops with questions.

Coworking Ops: Note: TwoBlock front desk will verify company list and issue day badges on arrival.

Renee (Facilities): Contractors scheduled for major HVAC repair Mon 9am-5pm; expect louder noise on ground level.

Sam (People Ops): Will send follow-up w/ FAQ and link to live temps in the workspace. Thanks everyone.

Anya: RSVP for TwoBlock pass submitted.
